name: Filmcity Media Limited
about: Filmcity Media Limited engages in the entertainment business in India. It publishes magazine for entertainment industry under the Filmcity brand; produces content for OTT; and creates and distributes content for web series, serials, and others. The company was formerly known as Kavita Prakashan Private Limited and changed its name to Filmcity Media Limited in June 1995. Filmcity Media Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.
